question: The ratio of the curved surface area to the total surface area of a solid cylinder is 3 : 5. If its volume is 12,936 cm³, what is its height? ({Use } pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of CSA to TSA = h / (h + r) = 3 / 5 ⇒ 3r = 2h ⇒ r = 2h / 3

Volume = π × r² × h = 12936

⇒ (22/7) × (2h/3)² × h = 12936

⇒ (88 / 63) × h³ = 12936

⇒ h³ = 12936 × (63 / 88) = 9261 ⇒ h = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Curved Surface Area (CSA) to Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 : 5

Volume of the cylinder (V) = 12,936 cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

TSA of cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• h = ? 
• r CSA : TSA = 3 : 5 Vol = 12936 cm³ 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA / TSA = 3 / 5

⇒ 2πrh / 2πr(h + r) = 3 / 5

⇒ h / (h + r) = 3 / 5

⇒ 5h = 3(h + r)

⇒ 5h = 3h + 3r

⇒ 2h = 3r

⇒ r = 2h / 3

Now, substituting the value of r in the volume formula:

⇒ V = π × r² × h

⇒ 12936 = (22/7) × (2h / 3)² × h

⇒ 12936 = (22/7) × (4h² / 9) × h

⇒ 12936 = (88 / 63) × h³

⇒ h³ = (12936 × 63) / 88

⇒ h³ = 147 × 63

⇒ h³ = 9261

⇒ h = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Cylinder

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area = 2πrh | Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r)

Properties of a Cone

Volume = (1/3)πr²h | Curved Surface Area = πrl | Total Surface Area = πr(l + r), where slant height l = √(r² + h²)

Properties of a Sphere

Volume = (4/3)πr³ | Total Surface Area = 4πr²
